$comment: Declared blocking-decision surfaces authored OUTSIDE the TypeScript population the
ratchets walk. Enforces the constitutional standard 'A Decision That Can Block Must
Live Where the Checks Can See It' (Standards Registry, The Substrate).
blocking[] is SHRINK-ONLY against blockingCeiling: migrate a decision into TypeScript
and lower the ceiling. Raising the ceiling is a deliberate, reviewable act.
nonBlocking[] is CONTENT-PINNED: a declared non-blocking script whose bytes change must
be re-declared. That closes the gap the declaration alone leaves open -- a file declared
non-blocking could otherwise silently acquire a refusal and stay unwatched.
Seeded 2026-08-06 from the controlled 2026-08-05 F10 census
MUST-BE-SHELL 0 / INCIDENTALLY-SHELL 12 / UNKNOWN 0 -- every one of the twelve can move.
